llm.summary: This is a coherent catalyst-design advisory skill with markdown knowledge files and no executable code or hidden data-handling behavior.

dimensions.detail: The skill asks only to read its packaged references/templates and optionally consume user-provided catalyst-search outputs; that access is proportionate to the advisory purpose.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Installation is documented as a standard skill install or manual copy, with no scripts, executables, package hooks, or automatic setup commands beyond the external SkillHub install command.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The workflow allows optional WebSearch/WebFetch for source tracing and describes backfilling its own methodology files when users provide new evidence; this is disclosed and scoped, though users should notice it may persist updates to the skill knowledge base.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The update protocol instructs appending or modifying the skill's own methodology and registry files for traceability, but it is purpose-aligned, disclosed, limited to packaged knowledge files, and not a broad persistence or privilege mechanism.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is catalyst design guidance, and the artifacts provide methodology references, a traceability registry, an update protocol, and a proposal template aligned to that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, understand that this skill is a research-assistance template for catalyst design, not a safety-validated lab protocol. Its only notable behavior is a disclosed option to update its own methodology registry from user-provided evidence; review those updates if you rely on the skill over time.
